3. Merge TMB with survival data by patient_id.
4. Use a Cox proportional hazards model (e.g., lifelines CoxPHFitter) with Surv(time,event) ~ TMB + age + gender + stage.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from lifelines import CoxPHFitter, KaplanMeierFitter
from lifelines.statistics import multivariate_logrank_test

# 1. Load mutation data and compute TMB
mut = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv')
ns = mut[mut['Variant_Classification'] != 'Silent']
tmb = ns.groupby('patient_id').size().reset_index(name='TMB')

# 2. Load clinical data and derive survival and covariates
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv')
clin['patient_id'] = clin['submitter_id']
clin['time'] = clin['days_to_death'].fillna(clin['days_to_last_followup'])
clin['event'] = clin['days_to_death'].notna().astype(int)
# Use age_at_diagnosis and gender; no AJCC stage column, so omit stage
covs = clin[['patient_id', 'time', 'event', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender']]

# 3. Merge with TMB
df = pd.merge(covs, tmb, on='patient_id', how='inner')
df = df.dropna(subset=['time', 'event', 'TMB', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender'])

# 4. Encode gender
df = pd.get_dummies(df, columns=['gender'], drop_first=True)

# 5. Cox model
cph = CoxPHFitter()
cph.fit(df.drop(columns=['patient_id']), duration_col='time', event_col='event')
print("CoxPH Model Summary:")
print(cph.summary)

# 6. Proportional hazards check
print("\nProportional Hazards Assumption Test:")
cph.check_assumptions(df.drop(columns=['patient_id']), show_plots=False, p_value_threshold=0.05)

# 7. KM curves by TMB tertiles
df['TMB_tertile'] = pd.qcut(df['TMB'], 3, labels=['Low', 'Mid', 'High'])
kmf = KaplanMeierFitter()
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
for grp in ['Low','Mid','High']:
    mask = df['TMB_tertile']==grp
    kmf.fit(df.loc[mask,'time'], event_observed=df.loc[mask,'event'], label=grp)
    kmf.plot_survival_function(ci_show=True)
plt.title('Survival by TMB Tertiles')
plt.xlabel('Time (days)')
plt.ylabel('Survival Probability')
plt.legend(title='TMB Tertile')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
results = multivariate_logrank_test(df['time'], df['TMB_tertile'], df['event'])
print(f"Log-rank test p-value: {results.p_value:.4f}")

# 8. Save dataset
out = df[['patient_id','time','event','TMB','age_at_diagnosis'] + [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('gender_')]]
out.to_csv('tmb_survival_dataset.csv', index=False)
print("Saved dataset to 'tmb_survival_dataset.csv'.")
